Hon'ble Jaspreet Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.376/2023,
under Sections 323, 336, 504, 506, 308 IPC, relating to police station Kaiserganj, District Bahraich.
At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted

that the applicant is seeking parity with the co-accused namely Vijay Kumar Yadav @ Vijay Kumar, who has already been granted the benefit of anticipatory bail by this Court by means of the order dated 08.05.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s. 438 Cr.P.C. No.959 of 2024.

sentences.text: It has also been informed that the other co-accused, namely, Ritesh Kumar Yadav alias Rinku and Maneesh Kumar Yadav, have also been granted the anticipatory bail by this Court by means of separate orders dated 25.05.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.1157/2024 and Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.1160 of 2024 and the copies of the said anticipatory bail orders are brought on record as Annexures No.18 and 19 respectively.

sentences.text: The submission of the learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
It is further urged that as per the medical report, the injuries on the injured Keshav Ram are of simple nature.
He was referred to the Department of Radiologist, which conduct X-ray and even the same did not indicate any alarming injury caused and suffered by the injured.
It is also urged that the injured himself has given a statement which is vague and spoken against the applicant and other co-accused, no specific averment or role has been ascribed.
Even the statement of the daughter does not support the version in the FIR.
It is further submitted that there is a cross FIR from the side of the co-accused, namely Vijay Kumar Yadav @ Vijay Kumar, wherein the injured along with others are named accused.

The informant of the cross FIR also received injuries and it has been urged that under such circumstances, it is a case of cross FIR where it has yet to be adjudicated that as to who was the aggressor as the co-accused himself received injuries.
The submission is that the applicant is ready to follow the conditions as prescribed under the law.
It is also submitted that the charge-sheet has been filed and there is no chance of tampering with the evidence or influence any witness.
It is urged that applicant has no criminal history.
In these facts and circumstances, it is prayed that the applicant may also be provided the benefit of anticipatory bail as the applicant is under an impending threat of being arrested.
Learned AGA,on the basis of material in the case diary available with him, has opposed the aforesaid the anticipatory bail, however, could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Having considered the submissions and considering the facts and circumstances including the nature and gravity of the accusation, the antecedents of the applicant including that he has no criminal history and no apprehension has been expressed that the applicant is at flight risk, hence,
this Court is of the opinion that the applicant can be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
